name: v21b_milli_life
description: Millipede is intrinsically ~135, NOT food-limited (litter amount/piles/regen all ruled out at long timescale). For a death-balanced population pop_eq ~ birth_rate x lifespan, so lifespan is the linear lever. Cut millipede lifespan_secs 6300->2400 (~38%). Default litter. LONG window to read the true equilibrium. Target ~50.
